message:
You know that feeling when you’ve been nudging your loved ones to think ahead about safety skills? Well, here’s a resource that backs us up! It’s a great reminder that preparedness isn’t just about having supplies, but also about knowing what to do in various situations. 

Taking a little time to explore these skills can empower all of us and make our homes even safer. So, let’s keep the conversation going and share what we learn. After all, a few minutes of preparation now could lead to a lot of peace of mind later! 😊
